name: Space Explorer
pitch: The child becomes captain of a tiny rocket and visits a string of friendly planets to deliver a lost star back to the sky.
setting: The Twinkle Belt, a cozy corner of space with a jelly-bean moon, a planet made of soft clouds, and a ringed planet that hums lullabies

supportingCast.name: Bolt
supportingCast.look: small silver robot dog with antenna ears and a blinking blue nose

supportingCast.name: Mira
supportingCast.look: friendly grandmother astronomer with silver braids and star-shaped glasses, seen on the rocket's round screen

supportingCast.name: Glimmer
supportingCast.look: a small, shy, glowing yellow star with a sleepy smile
